verdict.rationale: Insomnia is a desktop API client and design/testing tool. It sends requests and does not sit in the production traffic path, so monitoring gateway API traffic with metrics, logging and tracing integrations is a gateway or observability axis rather than an API-client capability. Nothing in the evidence shows Insomnia shipping traffic monitoring. The Konnect MCP mention concerns a separate Kong product, not Insomnia.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor API traffic with metrics, logging, and tracing integrations
